# Exact Gallery Frame Row diagnostic

Fixed product source: `e48fff46b3a92a28465ad74295bd273a9d69af7d`, Gallery `macos_modern`, release/min13. This package is an external CI diagnostic, not a product compatibility fix or a new UI component.

`build.py prepare SOURCE EVIDENCE` checks the exact tracked source and 631 original input hashes, resets only the generated target, and inserts one environment-gated external patch hook before `target.plan`. The original product plan then continues. `patch.py` accepts only the independently exported actual Gallery generated source and exact Style. It marks one existing Frame Row, retains its original queries/arithmetic/place order, and appends `RowLedger.swift`. Two mechanical reversible diffs and source hashes bind the compiled changes. `build.py collect` verifies the resulting source and product identities, including partial failures.

The logger snapshots values already computed by the original Row. It records actual ordinal/count, queries, normalized widths, offers, dimensions, and requested placement points. Only after the original placement finishes does it read an explicit own-PID stage arm and write a bounded packet (64 KiB / 64 complete placements). Nil/nonfinite values are explicit; truncation and I/O failure are not accepted as successful measurements. Offered width, actual extent, AX frame, and visible bezel remain distinct.

`FrameClosed.swift APP CLI OUTPUT EXPECTED_OS LABEL SOURCE_SHA` reuses the verified external Frame collector, retaining Ready→Paused0, >3.2s awake, own-PID/window selection, ICC and four equal buffer comparisons. It runs one closed capture, without AXPress. Control has no trace environment. Observer requires a fresh precreated `OUTPUT/ledger` through `BERN_FRAME_ROW_LEDGER_OUTPUT_DIR`; the collector arms before the existing Frame selection and binds the returned packet to its PID, token and stable-image timestamps. Local13 retains the explicit `BERN_FRAME_LOCAL_EVENTS=own-pid-active13` route and root's independent desktop/cleanup guard. No personal preference or TCC changes are performed by the collector.

`PixelGate.swift CONTROL_REPORT OBSERVER_REPORT FRESH_PAIR_JSON` binds the actual PNG/ICC to successful same-OS reports and compares native decoded active byte pixels without color conversion or resizing. The fixed Frame detail ROI is `[211,52,920,668]` points in a 920×668 outer window. Whole-window differences are reported separately. Passing this gate proves only the scoped observer did not change this Frame region; it is not cross-OS or whole-application acceptance.

The workflow builds the observed product and the two external helpers once with the newer SDK and min13. macOS14 first runs the existing exact original e48 artifact, then the observed product with the same collector. The same compiled observed product/helpers can subsequently run on local13. No old f9 screenshot is relabeled as e48. No padding, font, controlSize, color, or custom-control compensation is introduced.
